Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short sandbox + promotional allocation for our cohort

Hi Vivek,

I'm leading technical partnerships for NovaSeed's summer accelerator and we'd like to pilot Redwood as the inference backend for three teams in our July cohort. The asks: sandbox access for internal dev/test (≈3 seats), and a one-time promotional credit allocation large enough to run a 2-week spike (we estimate ~200k tokens).

We're planning lightweight demos and don't have an enterprise contract in place yet. If there's a streamlined playbook for accelerator partners (SOW template, TOS, expected turn-around), that would help us move quickly.

Quick context: cohort starts 2028-07-08, milestones: onboarding (week 0), pilot experiments (weeks 1–2). We're comfortable with a short pilot SOW and a usage cap.

Can you advise next steps and what information you need from us?

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Program Director — NovaSeed Labs
anika@novaseed.com

Hi Anika — thanks for reaching out and for the clear timeline.

We can usually support accelerator pilots like this with a short SOW + promo credit. Next steps from our side:
- Ben (cc'd) will own credit allocation and can confirm sizing and approvals.
- Olga (cc'd, partnerships onboarding) will send a one-page SOW template and the pilot TOS.
- We need a primary technical contact (email) and a brief security/data usage note from you (do the teams send any PII? will they connect to private data stores?).

Ben/Olga — assuming nothing unusual on the security side, can we provision sandbox seats and an initial promo of 250k tokens for a 2-week window (starting 2028-07-08)? If we need finance sign-off, we'll ask Anika to introduce the NovaSeed finance contact for a quick approval note.

Anika — I'll keep this thread so we have continuity.

Best,

Hi all — happy to move this forward. Quick summary of what I'll need to approve the allocation:
1) Signed one-page SOW (Olga, can we use the usual accelerator SOW?)
2) High-level security confirmation from the teams (whether they will send PII, and whether they'll use our hosted API or dedicated environment)
3) Confirmation of pilot dates and expected spend cap (you asked for ~200k tokens; I'm proposing a 250k token promo to give headroom).

Assuming items above are OK, I can approve a promo credit of 250,000 tokens for the two-week window. I'll route a memo to Finance for visibility (no extra paperwork if the promo is under our Accelerator discretionary budget).

I've attached the standard Pilot TOS and a draft SOW that Olga typically uses — please review and return an executed PDF.
